defaults.c: Clear, friendly colours on a light ground, with a calm colour for progress
defaults.t: Named teachers with credentials, syllabus, real outcomes with source, refund rule, accessibility statement
defaults.b: Free first lesson or trial; paid plans with a refund window

rows: Educational App
education, learning, lessons, quizzes, progress, students, teachers, curriculum
Show a real lesson and the progress view. Explain how learning is checked and keep child privacy rules explicit.
Online Course/E-learning
online course, e-learning, lessons, video, certificate, self paced, instructor, cohort
Syllabus and a free sample lesson first. Show the instructor, hours and refund rule, and certificates only if meaningful.
Language Learning App
language learning, vocabulary, speaking, lessons, streak, pronunciation, spaced repetition, fluency
Let people try a lesson before an account. Show the method and what level is reachable, and keep streaks forgiving.
Coding Bootcamp
coding bootcamp, web development, cohort, career, mentors, projects, outcomes, tuition
Publish audited outcomes with method and date. Show the syllabus, tuition options and what a week looks like.
Coding Challenge & Practice
coding challenges, practice, algorithms, editor, tests, leaderboard, problems, interview
The editor and test results are the page. Show difficulty and acceptance rates and give hints without spoiling.
Flashcard & Study Tool
flashcards, study, spaced repetition, decks, quiz, exam, memory, notes
Make cards in seconds and show the review schedule. Import and export decks in an open format.
Kids Learning (ABC & Math)
kids learning, abc, maths, early years, games, phonics, counting, children
Large targets, spoken prompts and no ads or chat. State the privacy approach for children and give a parent area.

rows.x: Vibrant & Block-based, Soft UI Evolution, Inclusive Design

rows: Music Instrument Learning
instrument learning, piano, guitar, practice, lessons, sheet music, tuner, feedback
Show real listening feedback and a practice plan. Offer slow-down and loop, and say what the app cannot teach.
Micro-Credentials/Badges Platform
micro credentials, badges, certificates, skills, verification, portfolio, open badges, employers
A badge is only as good as its verification: show the issuer, criteria and a public check link. Use open badge standards.
LMS (Learning Management System)
lms, learning management, courses, enrolments, assessments, reporting, scorm, administrators
Show the learner and the admin views both. List standards supported, reporting and data export, and accessibility conformance.
Academic Journal / Scholarly Publishing
journal, scholarly, peer review, articles, citations, doi, authors, submission
Show scope, review model, times to decision and indexing. Articles need doi, abstract, citation export and accessible PDFs.

rows.x: Minimalism & Swiss Style, E-Ink / Paper, Accessible & Ethical

rows: Research Lab / University Department
university, research lab, department, publications, people, projects, funding, students
People, projects and publications are the content. Keep it current, show how to join, and publish contact and location.

rows.s: Minimalism & Swiss Style + Editorial Grid / Magazine

rows: Conference / Symposium Landing Page
conference, symposium, call for papers, speakers, schedule, registration, venue, sponsors
Dates, place and the register button first, then the programme as a real schedule. Show deadlines and accessibility of the venue.
